marketing_description: The NUVO® Backlit Flat Panel (part 65-572R1) delivers 30 W of LED power with a 75 W bulb output, providing 3300–5750 lm at 3500 K and CRI 80+, suitable for utility‑style, flush‑mount applications. Its frosted PMMA lens and twist‑to‑focus 120° beam allow adjustable lighting, while the dimmable fixture operates from 120‑277 V, 60 Hz, and is housed in an aluminum/steel enclosure with an IP20 rating. The 2 ft × 4 ft rectangular panel is built for easy installation and long service life of 50 000 hr.
